description.value: The Consortium's only permanently crewed installation in the sector: five insulated modules, a vent laboratory and a landing apron, sunk half a metre into the flow front. Four people winter over and up to twenty are present when a ship is in. It is the address to which all correspondence for this galaxy is sent, and from which very little of it is answered promptly.

notes.value: Post arrives roughly twice a decade and is sorted, by long custom, into what is still true and what is not.
